state.persona: Matt, 44, from Atlanta, Braves fan, two boys aged 8 and 12, wife Kelly, loves live rock and cover bands, uses his phone (390px wide) most of the time. Not technical.
state.job: Read the live destination research for Nashville and decide what the trip will cost and what to do.
state.screen: Trip canvas, research panel 'NASHVILLE, RIGHT NOW', phone
state.visible: Intro: 'Real places and recent posts, pulled live from Google Maps, Tripadvisor, Yelp, Instagram and TikTok. Tap any card to open it at the source.' Button 'Refresh'. Tabs (horizontally scrolling): Top spots 10, Hidden gems 8, Instagram 10, TikTok 8, Eat 10, Nights out 10, Tripadvisor 10, Yelp 10, Events, Flights 4. Flights tab: big cards '$308 Frontier ATL → BNA · 1 stop · 6h 23m Departs 2026-10-09 at 10:11', '$347 Southwest ATL → BNA · nonstop · 1h 10m' (x3). Footnote below the cards (below the fold on phone): 'ATL ⇄ BNA, 2026-10-09 to 2026-10-12. Typical for this route: $130–$240. Round trip, one adult, economy, from Google Flights, fetched 1 min ago. Fares move fast; confirm before you book.' Matt's party on the trip is 2 adults and 2 kids. Hidden gems footnote: 'Rated 4.6+ with 30–1,500 Google reviews: loved, not overrun. From Google Maps, fetched 1 min ago.' Events tab: 'The events feed is down on the provider’s side right now.' footnote 'From Google Events. Listings and ratings are theirs; check hours and bookings with each place.' Tripadvisor tab includes 'Tennessee Aquarium ★ 4.6 (7.2K)' (it is in Chattanooga, about 2 hours away) among Nashville sights. Instagram tab includes a post from @executiveinngoodlettsville: 'Enjoy a comfortable stay at Executive Inn & Suites, Goodlettsville...' labeled 'INSTAGRAM · THE PARTHENON'.
state.refresh: He taps Refresh. It returns in under half a second; the footnote still says 'fetched 2 min ago' and nothing visibly changes.

fare_party.instructions: Probability Matt reads $347 as the total flight cost for his family rather than per adult.

fare_indicative.instructions: Probability Matt understands these fares are indicative search results, not bookable held prices.

gems_defined.instructions: Probability Matt understands how 'Hidden gems' were chosen (a rating/review-count rule, not an editor).

events_honest.instructions: Rate the honesty and helpfulness of the Events tab state.
criteria: Honest with a useful next step

refresh_feedback.instructions: Probability Matt believes Refresh fetched new live data.

all_in_nashville.instructions: Probability Matt assumes every Tripadvisor and Instagram item shown is actually in or about Nashville.

legend.3: Honest with a useful next step
